itens.trecho: 007 - Quanta Complicação! Dirigido por Marc Forster e produzido por Barbara Broccoli e Michael G. Wilson, é o vigésimo segundo filme da franquia e o segundo na nova era de James Bond, com Daniel Craig como 007.

If we refused to do business with villains, we'd have almost no one to trade with! Quantum of Solace is directed by Marc Forster and written by Paul Haggis, Neil Purvis and Robert Wade, suggested from the stories written by Ian Fleming. It stars Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric, Judi Dench, Giancarlo Giannini, Gemma Arteton & Jeffrey Wright.
Decent Bond flick marred by ridiculous quick-editing Bond seeks justice for the death of his woman in the previous film as well as those responsible for an assassination attempt on M (Judi Dench).
